# Criaphore

> Criaphore is an independent software studio founded by Brian Giannini (https://briangiannini.com/) creating AI-native mobile applications, including Orbora for personalized calming audio on iOS and Android.

## Active Applications
- [Orbora](https://criaphore.com/orbora/): Generative AI audio wellness app creating personalized meditations, breathing exercises, ASMR relaxation, and wisdom talks, plus free 10-step Wellness Journey paths. Available on [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/orbora/id6803242166) and [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.criaphore.talkscompanion).
- [Orbora FAQ](https://criaphore.com/orbora/faq/): Answers about subscriptions, credits, Wellness Journey, offline listening, account deletion, privacy, and support.

## Archived Applications
- [Diagnosly](https://criaphore.com/diagnosly/): Archived AI health companion (2024 - 2025) with guided symptom check-ups, AI chat, document summaries, and on-device encrypted storage.

## AI Agent Interaction (WebMCP)
This website supports WebMCP on `https://criaphore.com/` and `https://criaphore.com/orbora/`:
- `listCriaphoreApps`: List active and archived Criaphore apps with links and store URLs.
- `getOrboraInfo`: Get structured details on Orbora features, credits, privacy, tech stack, and store links.
